purpose: Teach: ハンサム/ニコチン/馬力/ハイウェイ/アスファルト/鰻/怪談/ニンジン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、若い頃はハンサムって有名だったわ
lines.en: You know, Sho, your father was quite famous for being handsome when he was young.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic tone. Soft smile in the voice. Slow, meandering pace like recalling a fond memory. Gaze turned inward, not at Sho directly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがニコチンガムで禁煙してらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, did you know Dad quit smoking with nicotine gum?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Gentle wonder — he's noticed something about his father that matters. Small voice, attentive. No urgency, just quiet pride.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが馬力の強いトラックを運転されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father drove such a powerful truck back then.
lines.style: Reminiscent half-smile in the voice. Slight admiration underneath. Wistful — she's remembering a version of him he no longer shows. Measured pace, lingering slightly on 'powerful'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとハイウェイドライブしたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to go on a highway drive with Dad!
lines.style: Sudden brightness, excited energy breaking through. Hopeful lean forward. Quick, eager tempo. Small voice still but animated — the idea has just captured him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭の通路にアスファルトを敷きましょうか
lines.en: Should we lay some asphalt down in the garden path, Sho?
lines.style: Gentle, wondering tone. She's offering him something, testing his interest. Warm but open-ended. Slight pause before the question, like she's thinking aloud with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、土用の鰻を食べたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat eel for Doyo Day!
lines.style: Sudden shift to immediate want. Bright, direct. Small boy's appetite and excitement. Quick delivery, the words tumbling out with genuine desire.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが怪談話を聞かせてくれたわね
lines.en: Your grandfather used to tell you ghost stories, didn't he, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate recall. Slight warmth on 'grandfather'. She's anchoring him in family memory. Slow pace. Trailing-off at the end — letting the memory linger.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんのニンジン煮、好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really like Grandma's carrot stew.
lines.style: Contented, genuine warmth. Simple statement of affection for something familiar and loved. Soft voice, unhurried. A quiet moment of closeness.
